measures.name: Load Factor
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Transported Passengers]), SUM('Main Data'[# Available Seats]))

measures.name: Performed vs Scheduled
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Departures Performed]), SUM('Main Data'[# Departures Scheduled]))

measures.name: Air Time %
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Air Time]), SUM('Main Data'[# Ramp-To-Ramp Time]))

measures.name: Carrier
measures.dax: IF(DISTINCTCOUNTNOBLANK('Main Data'[Carrier Name]) = 1, MAX('Main Data'[Carrier Name]), "Others")

measures.name: Air Time % (CH21)
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Air Time]), SUM('Main Data'[# Ramp-To-Ramp Time]))

calculated_dimensions.qlik:
=if([Flight Type]='Domestic, US Carriers Only', 'Open',
if([Flight Type]='International, Foreign Carriers', 'Negotiating', 'Closed'))
calculated_dimensions.dax: SWITCH([Flight Type], "Domestic, US Carriers Only", "Open", "International, Foreign Carriers", "Negotiating", "Closed")

semantic_gaps: $(Include=config.qvs) / $(Include=tracerowcount.qvs) are not in the repo: vFolderSourceData is the repo's Data Files folder (DataRoot parameter + relative Parquet paths); the row-count trace has no Power BI counterpart.
QVD, CSV and Access (Dimension Tables.mdb, OLEDB CONNECT32) sources -> Parquet converted by tools/convert_sources.py.

STORE [Aircraft Types] INTO Aircraft Types Transformed.qvd is a file side effect of the reload; the model has no equivalent (Power Query does not write files) and nothing in this document reads it back.
WHERE Exists(key) and Left Keep ([Main Data]) -> rows kept when their key is in [Main Data] (fnFactKeys, the distinct values of both concatenated fact sources).

Null-key 'Unknown' members the script adds for null fact keys (the Employment rows have no region or market: Carrier Operating Region 8 and Origin / Destination Markets 1,860 / 1,918 rows in QlikView) are not loaded: they associate with nothing in QlikView and would wrongly match blank keys in Power BI.
COMMENT TABLES / FIELDS USING the Comments.xls maps -> TMDL descriptions on the table and on every column of the commented field (a Qlik field comment applies to the field in every table).
Synthetic keys / $$SysTables: none in the model; every dimension relates to [Main Data] on its single key.
Month is a dual -> Month text sorted by the hidden Month__num column.

Drill-down group Time (Year > Month) and cyclic group Airline / Origin Country / Destination Country: report-level choices in Power BI (visual drill / field parameters); the parity grains cover each level.
The row-level Flight Type deal status (Funnel Chart) -> calculated column on Flight Types.
